description: This file contains PHP classes that define compilation logic for 'setfilter' and 'setfilterclose' tags within the Smarty templating engine's internal compiler. It manages variable filters during template compilation.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Setfilter
classes.description: Handles the compilation of the 'setfilter' tag by setting variable filters during template compilation.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Setfilterclose
classes.description: Handles the compilation of the '/setfilter' closing tag, resetting variable filters to previous state.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles code for the respective tag, setting or resetting variable filters in the Smarty internal compilation context.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attributes for the tag from the parser (used in 'Setfilterclose' class).
